applyAction :: Config -> PlayerId -> Action -> GameState -> Either GameError (GameState, ActionReport) Source #

Ap dung mot action cua nguoi choi. Kiem tra tran dang choi va dung luot, roi thuc hien action, roi xu ly ket qua (thang, thua, het AP thi doi luot).

endTurn :: Config -> GameState -> GameState Source #

Ket thuc luot hien tai. Sau luot cua Player2 thi sang vong moi, neu da het so vong thi tinh ket qua theo diem kho Earth. Nguoi den luot duoc nap day AP.

forfeit :: PlayerId -> GameState -> GameState Source #

Nguoi choi mat ket noi thi doi thu thang. Tran da ket thuc thi giu nguyen.
